posts.title: The Pursuit Of Purity (The Right Way To Do AI)
posts.description: I grew up in a very religious family. I don't view this fact as bad or good, but it's important to mention as part of the story I am telling in this blog post. As a teenager, most of my Friday nights were spent at youth group, volunteering to pray for people or tidying up at the end of the night....
